items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I love singing with James Ingram. He’s a dynamite – he’s a great, great singer. I love him a lot.

ctx.x: Bernard Benard[?]. They had brought him in to sing this song with me, which I had no clue what ever possessed them to think that that would work. There’s such a big, big difference in the tonal qualities and all that. So that didn’t work at all. That’s how I found Daryl Coley, because that was – oh, I love his voice, and we mesh, we blend. And James Ingram and I are like – it’s like, on fire. I love singing with James Ingram. He’s a dynamite – he’s a great, great singer. I love him a lot.
You’ve done some unusual collaborations, unusual in that they were just one-offs. You did some things with the Crusaders.
